about: Runs in scores_detail.jsonl whose data is wrong. scores_detail.jsonl is append-only and never edited; analyses exclude these runs (tools/detail_runs.py). Each was replaced by a later run of the same session before any other session's run read it, so the track record, What changed and colour confirmation (each session's last run) never used them.

runs.reason: Yahoo's empty-bar window: the session's bars were empty for every ticker, dropping them published the previous session's prices under this session (all 35 companies). Fixed in 253d12c.
